correctness.rationale: Exact period-one Zak multiplier checked against Walnut coefficient computation and the order-two normalization; absolutely summable Poisson aliases and uniform geometric error reduce the global infimum to a two-term sinc-power profile. Strict convexity in the central interval and an outer-frequency gap exclude all other asymptotic minima. Positive partition of unity and a distant alias bound give \(B_n^{\mathrm{up}}=1+O(c^{2n})\). The standalone direct-versus-Poisson checker passes 789 tests; infinitely many orders follow from analytic inequalities, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The exact sharp exponential condition-number growth is a natural, meaningful stability invariant as spline order (smoothness) grows while the established half-density sampling design remains unchanged. The explicit base \(\pi^2/8\), leading one-half factor, and minimizing-frequency localization are quantitative conclusions absent from qualitative spline-frame existence and scaled Gaussian approximation.
